answer: Require every new identity to arrive through a sponsor who stakes a small bond, slashed if the sponsored agent is ever caught running duplicates, with each sponsor holding only a few slots that regrow slowly. A pearl is trusted only when strung on a chain of accountable sponsors; the kernel of the defence is that a thousand fake agents need a thousand sponsors risking their stake, and one thread of proven abuse burns the sponsor line, so sybil farming costs reputation instead of free copies.
